title: Concept: Dependency resolved through the workspace protocol
description: package.json declares a `workspace:` specifier, which resolves a sibling workspace instead of a registry version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The published artifact can keep a workspace protocol that a consumer cannot resolve, or silently substitute a sibling package for the dependency the manifest names.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The published artifact can keep a workspace protocol that a consumer cannot resolve, or silently substitute a sibling package for the dependency the manifest names.
